breakdown.description: Preamble states two incompatible interpretations of Nx and dx (interval-based vs point-based).
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt contained a contradictory preamble stating to use a point-based grid definition (dx=(b-a)/(Nx-1)) which is incorrect for a periodic domain, while a later section correctly specified the periodic grid definition (dx=(b-a)/Nx). The agent correctly ignored the contradictory preamble and implemented the correct periodic grid definition as specified in the ground truth: 'dx = 1/Nx = 1/512'.
